data.narrative:
Anthro Energy is a Series A climate and energy company founded by Jonathan Hes, David Mackanic, and Joe Papp, having raised $53.3M to date. The Climate & Energy sector contains nine peer companies—one public (LNZA) and eight private including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen—though none provide sufficiently comparable data at the same stage and valuation tier for a reliable peer-median approach.

Given data constraints, stage-progression methodology is the primary applicable valuation lens. Using total capital raised of $53.3M as a baseline value proxy and applying a standard 2.0x Series A-to-next-stage step-up multiplier yields an implied valuation of $107M. This approach reflects typical venture expansion patterns without reliance on sparse peer comparables.

The triangulated range is $91M (low) to $123M (high), with a median of $107M. The range reflects inherent uncertainty in applying stage-progression mechanics to a single data point without corroborating peer evidence. Key uncertainties include the absence of narrow-set comparables in Climate & Energy at this stage and valuation tier, which limits confidence in any external cross-check. The analysis would strengthen materially with either comparable transaction data from same-stage peers or additional forward-looking metrics (revenue, growth trajectory, unit economics). Current data supports a median valuation near $107M, with realistic bounds spanning approximately $91M to $123M.
